commitments.detail: All collected data will be stored in an encrypted database and deleted after 90 days.
The research team will ensure the quality of the survey and its methodology.
Ensure data is stored securely in a database and deleted after 30 days.
Require written consent for future research uses beyond the initial study.
Ensure data is stored securely and only accessible to authorized personnel.
Implement measures to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the collected data.
Responses will be stored in an encrypted database.
The survey will be limited to 500 respondents to ensure manageable data handling.
No written consent is required as the survey is anonymous and open to all first-year students.
